text:
Maria Nguyen: quick handoff: Kestrel (P0) — AE team taking over today. Legal flagged KMS/HSM requirements and wants a short scoping doc + diagrams. Need answers on: who manages key wrap, where keys live, and whether HSM is required or customer-managed KMS is OK. pinging Eng/Infra for a short thumbsup 

Sam Patel: I can take the customer comms piece. can someone post the KMS diagram or point me to the runbook?

Linh Tran: I'll collect the infra answers. short note: for Dedicated we usually support customer KMS via key wrap; HSM only for Private on-prem deployments. will confirm exact flow.

Devon Cole: FYI the onprem package needs a 3rd-party HSM config if they want FIPS+attestation. otherwise BYOK with KMS keywrap is fine. also PSQ ticket needs to be created for deployment windows.

Maria Nguyen: thanks. Sam — can you delay customer update until we confirm HSM bit? want to avoid premature comms. :eyes:

Linh Tran: working on a 1-page diagram now. dropping assets into the deal folder: https://redwood.app/drive/kestrel-ops (will update permissions). 

Devon Cole: quick tech note for the diagram, include this snippet for key workflow: 
```
1. Customer KMS (optional) -> wrapped DEK sent to Redwood vault
2. Redwood vault stores wrapped DEK, unwrap happens within HSM when required
3. For Dedicated-hosted: unwrapping done in secure enclave, no customer HSM required
```

security-bot: Automated checklist: SOC2 doc present? NO. KMS diagram attached? PENDING. HSM required? TBD. Create ticket to track: #SEC-4821.

Sam Patel: thanks — I'll hold on external email. I'll create the PSQ ticket once Linh confirms the flow and Devon confirms the deployment window.

Maria Nguyen: blocker for today: need final wording for 'customer responsibilities' section in the SOW. Sam, can you draft and I'll iterate?

Sam Patel: yep — I'll draft a short paragraph and post here by EOD. :thumbsup:

Linh Tran: posted initial diagram v0.1 in the folder and commented with questions for infra; ETA ~90m for answers.

Devon Cole: I'll review the SOW paragraph for technical accuracy when Sam posts.

Maria Nguyen: perfect. no other blockers from sales side. feel free to @me if legal asks for more detail.

Sam Patel: noted. thanks team.

Linh Tran: marking as async standup: yesterday — synced with infra; today — finishing diagram + sec answers; blockers — need PSQ slot from infra ops.

Devon Cole: yesterday — validated onprem HSM path; today — confirm maintenance window; blocker — ops calendar conflict.

Maria Nguyen: yesterday — demo with customer; today — coordinate handoff + SOW; blocker — waiting on HSM confirmation.

security-bot: Reminder: attach the final diagram to #SEC-4821 and tag @security before customer-facing SOW is sent.

Sam Patel: will do. rolling this into the morning pulse.
